name: dsh-cost
description: Audit durable DSH usage-cost evidence and fail-closed budget checks without inventing missing usage or prices.

interface.shortDescription: Audit durable token-cost and budget evidence.
interface.longDescription: Fold durable DSH usage records or sanitized MCP usage rows under a caller-owned price book, exposing missing usage and unpriced routes instead of presenting partial totals as complete.
defaultPrompt: Check these sanitized usage rows against my price book and budget.
